The real seed was planted back in 2015 with a venture we called Project Salmon. That was my commercial pilot. We were providing discrete online solutions for sensitive issues like infertility—areas where women were suffering in silence due to social stigma and a complete lack of local facilities. We even opened an 'offline experience center' in Jammu and successfully facilitated IVF cycles. That was my 'aha' moment: I realized that a hybrid, 'phygital' model could actually work where a purely digital one might fail.

What I saw during those years was a disturbing pattern. While the metros were getting flooded with health apps, women in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns like Sunam and Patiala were still falling prey to quacks and unethical medical practices. They had smartphones and the financial means, but zero access to judgment-free, professional advice.

I knew that to fix this, I couldn't just rely on business logic. I went back to school for a Healthcare Management specialization at ISB to truly understand the clinical-business framework. I then brought on Dr. Nipunbir Singh as my co-founder to ensure we had world-class clinical depth. Carewell 360 is the culmination of that entire decade of learning.\
